children: The Warship is capable of undertaking LIMO, Target Deployment and Trials Platform, Unmanned/ autonomous System Mothership, HADR, conversion to a limited hospital ship and fighting for salvage operations
The Indian Navy is set to commission
at Naval Base, Karwar on 16 October 2026. Built by Larsen and Toubro under the Government of India's Make in India initiative.
is the first of four multi-Purpose Vessels being inducted into the Indian Navy. The motto of the ship is ‘Victory is Our Sole Aim’.

The commissioning will mark another significant milestone in India's drive towards defence self-reliance, and she will form an important component of the Navy’s future and ideal “utility” ship for strategically important operations.
Designed primarily for maritime surveillance and patrol,

is also capable of undertaking Low Intensity Maritime Operations (LIMO), Target Deployment and Trials Platform, Unmanned/ autonomous System Mothership, Humanitarian Assistance and Disaster Relief (HADR), conversion to a limited hospital ship and fighting for salvage operations.
Her integrated combat suite combines indigenous sensors, weapons and electronic systems specifically optimized for operations in the challenging maritime environment.
, features the formidable Indian elephant emerging from the waves, symbolising strength, intelligence and agility.
